description: This file is a shell script that implements various self-healing and diagnostic functions for a device. It handles process management, system diagnostics, reboot procedures, and communication with device properties and configuration settings. The script is likely part of a larger device management system, specifically for troubleshooting and maintaining device stability in a network environment.

methods.name: getstat
methods.description: Reads /proc/stat, extracts CPU statistics for usage calculation.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a specific field from a string based on a delimiter.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Calculates the difference between statistics entries for resource usage.

methods.name: getVendorName
methods.description: Retrieves the vendor/manufacturer name of the device.

methods.name: getModelName
methods.description: Retrieves the model name of the device.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Gets current date/time in specified format.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Gets current date/time with nanoseconds.

methods.name: getCMMac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device.

methods.name: checkConditionsbeforeAction
methods.description: Checks network registration, voice call, and traffic conditions before performing an action.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Performs a reset of the router by checking registration states and then rebooting if conditions are met.

methods.name: rebootNeeded
methods.description: Determines if a reboot is necessary based on various conditions, updates reboot counters, and initiates reboot.

methods.name: checkCaptivePortal
methods.description: Checks whether captive portal configuration needs to be enabled based on network responses and flags.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Performs process resets based on diagnostics, including starting/stopping services and executing reboots.

methods.name: storeInformation
methods.description: Stores system and resource information for troubleshooting purposes.

methods.name: logNetworkInfo
methods.description: Logs details about network interfaces, routing tables, and connected devices for diagnostics.

methods.name: CheckRebootCretiriaForAtomHang
methods.description: Checks and resets these criteria for certain device models and types related to atom hang detection.

methods.name: SetRebootConfigForAtomHang
methods.description: Sets configuration to allow reboot after atom hang detection.

methods.name: setRebootreason
methods.description: Sets the reason and counter for the last reboot in device configuration.

methods.name: CheckAndProceedFurtherBasedonDiagnosticMode
methods.description: Checks if the device is in diagnostic mode, and prevents reboot/reset during that time.

methods.name: checkMaintenanceWindow
methods.description: Checks if current time is within a scheduled maintenance window for firmware updates.
